metadata.currency: Text contains those laws in effect on April 8, 2026

children.label: (a)
children.heading: In general
children.text: There is hereby imposed a tax of $3 per passenger on a covered voyage.

children.label: (b)
children.heading: By whom paid
children.text: The tax imposed by this section shall be paid by the person providing the covered voyage.

children.label: (c)
children.heading: Time of imposition
children.text: The tax imposed by this section shall be imposed only once for each passenger on a covered voyage, either at the time of first embarkation or disembarkation in the United States.

other_notes.heading: Prior Provisions
other_notes.text: A prior section 4471 was contained in subchapter C of this chapter prior to repeal by Pub. L. 89–44, title IV, §404, June 21, 1965, 79 Stat. 149 .

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.effective_date: apply to voyages beginning after December 31, 1989, which were not paid for before such date.
notes.text: Pub. L. 101–239, title VII, §7504(c), Dec. 19, 1989, 103 Stat. 2363 , provided that: "(1) In general.-The amendments made by this section [enacting this subchapter] shall apply to voyages beginning after December 31, 1989, which were not paid for before such date. "(2) No deposits required before april 1, 1990.-No deposit of any tax imposed by subchapter B of chapter 36 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as added by this section, shall be required to be made before April 1, 1990."
